newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo declines comment on Lonrho report.
newsitem.headline: Anglo declines comment on Lonrho report.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Friday that it had no comment to make on a report in the Financial Times newspaper that the European Union is set to ban it from keeping a 28 percent stake in British conglomerate Lonrho Plc.

The European Commission is looking at the stake and has until May 5 to deliver a final decision. An investigation opened in December is examining the competition implications of the move in the platinum and rhodium markets.
"We simply are not going to comment on something that is an ongoing process," said Anglo spokesman Michael Spicer.
In April last year the Commission blocked the merger of the platinum interests of Lonrho and South Africa's Gencor because the market would be dominated the company.
Earlier, a Commission spokesman played down the press report saying it was still too early to draw any conclusions from the investigation.

The Financial Times said the Commission was about to inform Anglo of its objections, but the Commission spokesman said they were sent weeks ago and South African industry sources said there was a continuous exchange of information from both sides.
